description: This file declares an abstract class `AudioFrameBuffer` in the `cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming` namespace, defining an interface for audio frame buffer operations such as retrieving sample properties and data.

classes.name: AudioFrameBuffer
classes.description: An abstract class representing a buffer of audio frames, providing virtual methods to access properties like bits per sample, sample rate, channels, frames, and the data itself.

methods.name: bits_per_sample
methods.description: Returns the number of bits per audio sample.

methods.name: sample_rate
methods.description: Returns the sample rate of the audio data.

methods.name: channels
methods.description: Returns the number of audio channels.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns the number of audio frames.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the constant uint8_t audio data buffer.
